body:
Founder real-time: "i have the rig provided skeleton and the model how do i attach themm add to
golden band readme in blender." GOLDENBAND had no README.md at all (CLAUDE.md only) -- created
one.

Core content answers the literal question (attaching a rig-provided skeleton + a model): open
TylerRig.blend (repo root or tools/blender_export/), position the model around it, Ctrl+P ->
"With Automatic Weights" to skin, save uncompressed. Then two export paths depending on setup --
upload the .blend to incoming/ via GitHub's website for automatic CI export (no local Blender
scripting needed, matches the founder's own known disk-space-constrained-on-Windows situation
per the blender-tools.yml workflow's own comment), or run export_gband_rig.py locally/headless.
Everything cross-checked against real files already in the repo (TylerRig.blend x2,
tools/blender_export/*.py's own header comments, incoming/README.md, .github/workflows/
blender-tools.yml) rather than reconstructed from the northstar doc alone, which had gone
slightly stale -- export_gband_rig.py's header now says it was verified against a real Blender
5.2 install on 2026-08-05 (3 real bugs found and fixed then), not "unrun/unverified" as
GoblinFoxDragon/docs2/GOLDENBAND_INTEGRATION_NORTHSTAR.md still says.
title: Created README.md with Blender rig-attachment instructions
